const std = @import("std");

    const _result_json = try tree_sitter_language_pack.process("def first():\n    x = 1\n    return x\n\ndef second():\n    y = 2\n    return y\n\ndef third():\n    z = 3\n    return z\n", "{\"chunk_max_size\":50,\"language\":\"python\"}");
